audit_items.proof_trace: BeaconProposerIndexAtSlot falls back to on-demand computation when requesting slots outside current/next epoch range (line 326-331), or when epoch <= stateEpoch but cache lookup fails (line 334-356), violating the invariant that pre-calculated lookahead must always be used in Fulu. Lines 358-371 perform expensive on-demand computation via Seed + ActiveValidatorIndices + ComputeProposerIndex.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker triggers lookups for past epoch slots (e.g., e < stateEpoch - 1) on post-Fulu states, forcing on-demand computation. By repeatedly requesting historical proposer indices via P2P or consensus operations, attacker causes DoS through expensive active validator set iteration and seed-based proposer selection, bypassing the lookahead optimization that EIP-7951 was designed to enforce.
